scripts.prepare:runtime: npm run prepare:kiwi && npm run prepare:transformers && npm run prepare:models
scripts.prepare:runtime:hosted: npm run clean:hosted-browser-assets && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:browser-edit-tagger:bundled
scripts.prepare:runtime:pages: npm run clean:hosted-browser-assets && npm run prepare:kiwi && npm run prepare:transformers && npm run prepare:models
scripts.build: npm run prepare:runtime && tsc -b && vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:hosted: npm run prepare:runtime:hosted && tsc -b && vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:pages: npm run prepare:runtime:pages && tsc -b && vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
